jobs.title: AEM Technical Lead - Octopus by RTG - 6 Months
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Director of Software Engineering (Full-Stack) to lead multidisciplinary engineering, QA, and content teams while overseeing the delivery of enterprise-scale digital platforms powered by Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). The role is responsible for delivery governance, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and ensuring high-quality digital experiences across multiple markets.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and manage multidisciplinary teams of Software Engineers, QA Specialists, and CMS Content Authors.
  • Define team structure, capacity planning, and resourcing.
  • Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous professional development.
  • Own delivery governance, including sprint planning, prioritization, risk management, and reporting to client and internal stakeholders.

AEM Content Operations & Editorial Management

  • Oversee the creation, update, and maintenance of editorial, campaign, and product pages across multiple regional websites.
  • Govern news publishing, content archival, and content hygiene.
  • Manage offers, campaigns, competitions, forms, brochures, galleries, and downloadable assets.
  • Oversee dealer and showroom pages, pricing updates, locations, timings, and vehicle model information.
  • Ensure effective use of AEM native tooling, components, sheet-based management, and eCommerce content.
  • Oversee vehicle landing pages, configurator pages, kiosk pages, and model data authoring.

Digital Asset Management (DAM)

  • Oversee the upload, organization, and governance of digital assets.
  • Ensure assets are optimized and reusable across markets.
  • Govern brochure and model-year asset lifecycles.

Product Information Management (PIM)

  • Direct centralized model data management, including model-year updates, specifications, pricing, and product changes.
  • Coordinate model rollouts across regional markets.
  • Enable compare, configurator, and prices & specifications pages using PIM data.
  • Ensure accurate and reusable product data across all markets.

Forms, Lead Management & Feature Enablement

  • Oversee campaign, lead, feedback, and dealer forms.
  • Prioritize and enable new features based on business requirements.

Digital Services & Web Applications

  • Own the maintenance and enhancement of in-showroom web applications.
  • Oversee release management, version control, and application updates.
  • Drive feature enhancements and UX improvements.
  • Ensure synchronization between applications, AEM, and PIM.

SEO, Performance & Quality

  • Oversee SEO implementation and technical monitoring.
  • Ensure performance, accessibility, and quality standards through robust QA processes.

Localization & Market Enablement

  • Oversee market setup and localization of pages, assets, and product data.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of market-specific content.

Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the senior technical point of contact for client and market stakeholders.
  • Establish training, adoption, and feedback governance.
  • Communicate updates, enhancements, and roadmaps while driving continuous improvement.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in digital delivery, web engineering, or technical program management.
  • 3+ years in a technical leadership or director-level role.
  • Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) solutions.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering, QA, and content teams.
  • Strong delivery governance and stakeholder management experience.
  • Experience with DAM and PIM systems.
  • Experience overseeing custom web application maintenance and enhancement.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Technical Skills

Content Management & AEM

  • Adobe Experience Manager (Sites, Assets, and authoring workflows)
  • AEM native components, templates, and sheet-based content tooling
  • Headless/hybrid content delivery
  • Multi-market content architecture

Digital Asset & Product Information Management

  • DAM structuring, asset optimization, and reuse strategies
  • PIM-driven product data models

Web Application Development & Support

  • Modern web application stacks
  • Front-end frameworks
  • API integrations
  • Application performance monitoring
  • Release management

SEO, Performance & Localization

  • Technical SEO
  • Performance optimization
  • Accessibility standards
  • Internationalization (i18n)
  • Multi-market localization

DevOps & Delivery

  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Git
  • Agile/Scrum
  • QA processes
  • Test automation
  • Quality governance

Nice to Have

  • Adobe Experience Manager or Adobe Experience Cloud certifications.
  • Experience in automotive or other multi-brand, multi-market digital sectors.
  • Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP.
  • Experience with AEM as a Cloud Service.
  • Prior experience within a digital agency or consultancy delivery model.

Soft Skills

  • Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with commercial and client awareness.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

jobs.title: AI Designer - On-Site - Abu Dhabi - 6 Months - Octopus by RTG
jobs.description:
About Octopus by RTG

Octopus by RTG is the tech hiring and outsourcing arm of Robusta Technology Group, dedicated to connecting exceptional tech talent with top-tier organizations across the MENA, GCC, Europe, the US, and Canada. We specialize in building strong, long-term partnerships between skilled professionals and innovative companies. Our mission is to empower growth, innovation, and excellence by matching the right talent with the right opportunities.

About the Role

We’re looking for a seasoned AI Designer to shape the next generation of intelligent and conversational experiences. You’ll design how people interact with AI across global search, conversational assistance, and transactional journeys — transforming complex data and flows into simple, elegant, and human experiences.

You’ll collaborate closely with product, design system, and AI teams to bring AI-driven interactions and components to life, ensuring every experience feels cohesive, intuitive, and aligned with the brand’s tone of voice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design intuitive AI-led user experiences across chat, search, and contextual assistance.
  • Translate traditional UI elements (cards, menus, forms) into AI components such as structured prompts, dynamic replies, and conversational layouts.
  • Partner with UX writers and data teams to define tone, flow, and logic of conversations.
  • Work closely with the Design System team to evolve it into a conversational design framework.
  • Prototype and test AI-driven experiences using tools like Figma, Voiceflow, or Protopie.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure alignment between conversational and visual experiences.
  • Explore opportunities for AI-led personalization and contextual recommendations.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in digital product design, UX/UI, or interaction design.
  • Experience designing for AI or conversational interfaces (chatbots, search, assistants).
  • Strong understanding of component-based design systems and how they extend into conversational experiences.
  • Proficiency with Figma and prototyping tools (Voiceflow, Protopie, or similar).
  • Knowledge of AI UX principles — prompt design, response hierarchy, and tone management.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills with cross-functional teams.
  • Passion for AI-driven experience design and emerging human–AI interaction trends.

Why Join?

  • This is an opportunity to define how users discover, transact, and engage with digital products through intelligent, conversational design. You’ll play a key role in shaping the foundation of an AI-first design practice, blending creativity, systems thinking, and innovation.
